definitions.explanation: A single minute of clock time or duration. Often used loosely for "a moment", as in {一分|いっぷん}{待|ま}って (hang on a second).

examples.japanese: あと{一分|いっぷん}です。
{一分|いっぷん}だけ{待|ま}ってください。
{電子|でんし}レンジで{一分|いっぷん}{温|あたた}めてから、よく{混|ま}ぜてください。
examples.english: Heat it in the microwave for one minute, then mix it well.

notes:
The counter {分|ふん} changes shape after certain numbers: いっぷん, にふん, さんぷん, よんぷん, ごふん, ろっぷん, ななふん, はっぷん, きゅうふん, じゅっぷん. Learners should memorise this set as a block rather than one number at a time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一分間|いっぷんかん}: for one minute (duration)
- {一分|いっぷん}{以内|いない}: within one minute
- {一分|いっぷん}{一秒|いちびょう}を{争|あらそ}う: to be a race against the clock

USAGE:
The same characters read いちぶ mean "one part" or "one tenth", as in {一分|いちぶ}の{隙|すき}もない (without the slightest opening). Context and reading, not the writing, tell the two apart.
